items.title: File Boston business certificate (DBA) with the City Clerk
items.description: Businesses operating under a trade name file a business certificate with the City Clerk and renew it every four years; corporations and LLCs must first be registered with the Secretary of the Commonwealth.

items.title: File a Cambridge business certificate (DBA)
items.description: Anyone conducting business in Cambridge under a name other than their own files a notarized business certificate; it runs four years and is renewed through the clerk.

items.title: File a Lowell business certificate (DBA)
items.description: A business certificate is filed in person with the City Clerk, with a workers' compensation affidavit; it is valid four years and is not a business license.

items.title: File a Quincy business certificate (DBA)
items.description: Under the city code, anyone doing business in Quincy under a name other than their real name files a certificate with the City Clerk, valid four years.

items.title: File a Springfield business certificate (DBA)
items.description: Persons or corporations conducting business in Springfield under a company name file a business certificate with the City Clerk; it is valid four years and renewable.

items.title: File a Worcester business certificate (DBA)
items.description: Anyone doing business in Worcester under a name other than their own files a business certificate with the City Clerk (M.G.L. c. 110); it is valid four years and renewable, and is not a business license.
